embed.title: !ask
embed.description: Describe what you want to be alerted about in plain English, and the bot suggests the command to run. Nothing is tracked until you run that command yourself.

fields.name: Examples
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}ask perfect dragonite`
`{{prefix}}ask level 5 raids`
`{{prefix}}ask stardust quests`

fields.name: What you get back
fields.value: A suggested command to copy and paste, or a short numbered list when your request could mean more than one thing. Check the suggestion before you run it.
